name: Ilona
short_description:
This wine with a cute name and sparkling label was created by blending three varieties consisting of Burgundac sivi (Pinot Gris), Italian Riesling (Grašac) and Smederevka.

In several attempts to find the ideal ratio, it was concluded that exactly one third of each variety produces a wine in which no single variety dominates, and each brings out its best qualities. Burgundy Gray gives it fullness and extractiveness, Italian Riesling minerality and very interesting aromatic tones of white flowers, peaches, pears… while Smedereva gives it freshness and vibrant acids. With a pleasant 12.5% ​​alcohol, this wine is ideal for pairing with pasta dishes, light appetizers, river fish, seafood, as well as chicken and pork dishes with white sauces.
description:
TASTE:Minerality from Grašac, freshness and vibrant acidity of Smederevka, fullness and extractiveness of Burgundy.

FRAGRANCE: Interesting aromatic tones of white flowers, peach, pear…

FOOD: Ideal for pairing with pasta dishes, light appetizers, river fish, seafood, as well as chicken and pork dishes with white sauces.

name: Ilona
short_description:
Ovo vino simpatičnog naziva i vrcave etikete nastalo je kupažom tri sorte koju čine Burgundac sivi, Italijanski rizling (Grašac) i Smederevka.

U više pokušaja da se nađe idealan odnos, došlo se do zaključka da tačno po trećina svake sorte daje vino u kom ni jedna sorta ne dominira, a svaka iznedri svoje najbolje osobine. Burgundac sivi daje mu punoću i ekstraktivnost, Italijanski rizling mineralnost i jako interesante aromatske tonove belog cveća, breskve, kruške… dok mu smederevka daje svežinu i vibrantne kiseline.  Sa prijatnih 12,5 % alkohola ovo vino je idealno za uparivanje sa jelima od testa, lakim mezetlucima, rečnom ribom, morskim plodovima, kao i jelima od piletine i svinjskog mesa sa belim sosovima.
description:
UKUSI: Mineralnost od grašca, svežina i vibrantne kiseline smederevke, punoća i ekstraktivnost burgundca sivog.

MIRISI: Interesanti aromatski tonovi belog cveća, breskve, kruške…

HRANA: Idealno za uparivanje sa jelima od testa, lakim mezetlucima, rečnom ribom, morskim plodovima, kao i jelima od piletine i svinjskog mesa sa belim sosovima.

name: Egregor
short_description:
Egregor represents a complex metaphysical concept from the Hellenic era, but in the shortest definition, it refers to a common set of thoughts and emotions of all mental entities in one place that share a common motivation, including from the micro environment, such as the family, to the macro environment, which can be entire nations.

For this reason, we considered that the term is an almost ideal name for this wine, which with all its attributes has the characteristics of an Egregor for all those who will find their inspiration and connection with others similar to themselves while enjoying this wine.
description:
TASTE: We will let you discover the deep space and multi-layered nature of this wine for yourself, but we will tickle your imagination by noticing that this wine is characterized by exceptional extractiveness, elegant soft tannins, as well as almost imperceptible phenomenally balanced alcohols of around 14%, and a clear dominance of the Župa terroir, both in aroma and taste.

FOOD: This wine will go perfectly with the most demanding dishes with intense flavors and spices based on red meat and game, but it will also be a perfect pair with barbecue specialties, as well as dishes of increasingly popular Asian cuisine dominated by soy sauce or teriyaki sauce.

NOTE: Decanting is recommended for a minimum of 15 to 30 minutes, preferably longer.

name: Askurđel
short_description:
Askurđel is a blend of Italian Riesling and autochthonous Smederevka, from the already well-known Varina region in the vicinity of the village of Trnavci in the wine-growing Župa. The specific microclimate of the location, as well as the base consisting of white volcanic tuff, known in Župa as belobrežina, gives it an exceptional minerality as well as a special fruity, almost muscat aromatic character, although not a single muscat variety participates in the blend itself.

He took his name from the term that represents the ancestor of the seventh generation, which in this particular case is also the ancestor of the family who first took the surname Radenkovic.

With a pleasant acidity behind which an almost imperceptible 13% alcohol is hidden, it will go fantastically well with white meat, white sauces, white fish, all kinds of salads, as well as all kinds of dough and pizza, and it will not be in conflict with the grill.
description:
TASTE: Extraordinary minerality.

FRAGRANCE: A special fruity, almost muscat aromatic character, although not a single muscat variety participates in the blend itself.

FOOD: It will go fantastically well with white meat, white sauces, white fish, all kinds of salads, as well as all types of dough and pizza, and will not be at odds with the grill.

name: Burgundac sivi – Pinot Gris
short_description:
Burgundac sivi is a 100% varietal wine made from the variety of the same name (Pinot grigio, Pinot gris). This wine is an Alsatian type wine with an extremely strong character, strong oily body, intense flavor and high but well-balanced alcohol of 13.5%.

It is rich in aromas of southern fruits, pear, melon, with a long almond finish.

It is recommended exclusively with a good bite of river fish such as catfish, perch, carp, as well as with sea fish and various roasts with an intense flavor, whose texture will blend with the complex structure and full flavor of this wine. It was created out of love for the variety and as a desire of the owner of the winery to create a wine from the said variety that he himself wanted to enjoy.
description:
TASTE: Alsatian type wine, extremely strong character, strong oily body, intense flavor and high but well balanced alcohol of 13.5%.

FRAGRANCE Abundant aromas of southern fruit, pear, melon, with a long almond finish.

FOOD: It is recommended exclusively with a good bite of river fish such as catfish, perch, carp, as well as with sea fish and various roasts with an intense flavor.

name: Nestor
short_description:
Nestor is a wine born from the Žilavka variety, which the ancestors of the Radenkovic family discovered during their travels through Herzegovina. Captivated by the potential of the variety in the Herzegovinian karst, they brought vines in their saddlebags on their horses, which they grafted and planted on the white sandy mineral substrate of the volcanic tuff of the magical Varina as far back as 1931.

An old vineyard without a lean-to, so called. župska planting, still keeps well and produces grapes that produce potent wines with an intense, strong body, rich in extract and rarely less than 13.5% alcohol, which is what this particular wine has. The aromas of this wine, although varietal, are also tickled by the specifics of the locality, which we will not describe to you, but will let you discover them yourself.

Because of the vineyard from which the grapes are grown, it has a name domesticated in the Byzantine Empire, which already has an epithet of an old Serbian name, it comes from Hellenic mythology from the wise and long-lived king Nestor, and in our people it is a synonym for a wise old man, which this vineyard certainly is in a way.
description:
TASTE: Potential wine with an intense, strong body rich in extract with 13.5% alcohol

FRAGRANCE: The aromas of this wine, although varietal, are also tickled by the specifics of the locality, which we will not describe to you, but will let you discover them yourself.

FOOD: Nestor will pair very nicely with all types of fresh, smoked river and sea fish, it will perfectly accompany all types of roasts, goat cheese and other cheeses with an intense flavor that can be made from oil.

name: Shiraz
short_description:
This wine is the fruit of the creator’s desire to create a Shiraz that he himself would like to enjoy. It was born from triple fermentation in separate vessels with two different selected and one wild yeast.

That approach gave it a wide variety of aromas and flavors. The first impression of the smell is a slight smoke, an aroma that can be given by fermentation on wild yeasts, however the smell quickly evolves towards black and small forest fruits, which can be clearly felt in the taste.

This wine does not need to be decanted, as it has been aged in prochrome vessels, and has soft tannins, medium body and a pleasant 12.5% ​​alcohol content. It is dark red in color with purple hues.

At the table, it will pair perfectly with meats with a stronger structure and more intense flavor such as beef and lamb, as well as various steaks and ribs from the grill, pasta dishes dominated by red and meat sauces, as well as hard strong cheeses.

name: Shiraz
short_description:
Ovo vino plod je želje tvorca da kreira Shiraz u kakvom bi i sam želeo da uživa. Rođen je trostrukom fermentacijom u odvojenim sudovima sa dva različita selekcionisana i jednim divljim kvascem.

Taj pristup dao mu je širok diverzitet aroma i ukusa. Prvi utisak na mirisu je blagi dim, aroma kakvu može dati fermentacija na divljim kvascima, međutim miris brzo evoluira ka crnom i sitnom šumskom voću, koje se može jasno osetiti i u ukusu.

Ovom vinu nije neophodno dekantiranje, jer je odležalo u prohromskim sudovima, te je mekih tanina, srednjeg tela i sa prijatnih 12,5% alkohola. Zatvoreno crvene boje je, sa purpurnim nijansama.

Za trpezom će se savršeno upariti sa mesima jače strukture i intenzivnijeg ukusa poput goveđeg i jagnjećeg, zatim raznim stekovima i rebarcima sa roštilja, jelima od testa kojima dominiraju crveni i mesni sosovi, kao i tvrdim jakim sirevima.
description:
UKUSI: Ovo vino plod je želje tvorca da kreira Shiraz u kakvom bi i sam želeo da uživa. Rođen je trostrukom fermentacijom u odvojenim sudovima sa dva različita selekcionisana i jednim divljim kvascem. Taj pristup dao mu je širok diverzitet aroma i ukusa.

MIRISI: Prvi utisak na mirisu je blagi dim, aroma kakvu može dati fermentacija na divljim kvascima, međutim miris brzo evoluira ka crnom i sitnom šumskom voću, koje se može jasno osetiti i u ukusu. Ovom vinu nije neophodno dekantiranje, jer je odležalo u prohromskim sudovima, te je mekih tanina, srednjeg tela i sa prijatnih 12,5% alkohola. Zatvoreno crvene boje je, sa purpurnim nijansama.

HRANA: Za trpezom će se savršeno upariti sa mesima jače strukture i intenzivnijeg ukusa poput goveđeg i jagnjećeg, zatim raznim stekovima i rebarcima sa roštilja, jelima od testa kojima dominiraju crveni i mesni sosovi, kao i tvrdim jakim sirevima.

name: Nestor
short_description:
Nestor je vino rođeno od sorte Žilavka koju su preci familije Radenković spazili tokom proputovanja kroz Hercegovinu. Opčinjeni potencijalom sorte u hercegovačkom kršu, u bisagama na konjima doneli su vioke koje su okalemili i zasadili na beloj peskovito mineralnoj podlozi vulkanskog tufa čarobne Varine još daleke 1931. godine.

Stari vinograd bez naslona, tzv. župske sadnje, i dalje se dobro drži i daje grožđe od kog nastaju potentna vina intenzivog, jakog tela bogatog ekstraktom i retko kad manje od 13,5% alkohola, koliko i ovo vino konkretno ima. Arome ovog vina, iako sortne, golicaju i specifikumom lokaliteta koje Vam nećemo opisati, već ćemo Vas pustiti da ih sami otkrijete.

Zbog  vinograda iz koga je  grožđe, nosi ime odomaćeno u vizantijskom carstvu koje već ima epitet i starog srpskog imena, potiče iz helenske mitologije od mudrog i dugovečnog kralja Nestora, a u našem narodu predstavlja sinonim za mudrog starca, što ovaj vinograd na neki način svakako jeste.
description:
UKUSI: Potentno vino intenzivog, jakog tela bogatog ekstraktom sa 13,5% alkohola

MIRISI: Arome ovog vina, iako sortne, golicaju i specifikumom lokaliteta koje Vam nećemo opisati, već ćemo Vas pustiti da ih sami otkrijete.

HRANA: Nestor će se jako lepo upariti sa svim vrstama kako sveže, tako i dimljene rečne i morske ribe, savršeno će ispratiti sve vrste pečenja, koziji i ostale sireve intenzivnog ukusa koji mogu biti i iz ulja.

name: Egregor
short_description:
Egregor predstavlja jedan višeznačni složeni metafički pojam iz helenskog doba, ali najkraćom definicijom odnosi se na zajednički skup misli i emocija svih duševnih entiteta na jednom mestu koji dele zajedničku motivaciju, a podrazumevajući ih od mikro okruženja kao što je porodica, do makro okruženja što mogu biti čitave nacije.

Iz tog razloga smatrali smo da je pojam gotovo idealan naziv za ovo vino koje svim svojim atributima ima osobine Egregora za sve one koji će naći svoju inspiraciju i povezanost sa sebi sličnima uživajući u ovom vinu.
description:
UKUSI: Pustićemo vas da sami otkrijete dubok svemir i višeslojnost ovog vina, ali ćemo vam zagolicati maštu opažanjem da ovo vino karakteriše izuzetna ekstraktivnost, elegantni meki tanini, kao i gotovo neprimetni fenomenalno balansirani alkoholi od oko 14%, te jasna dominacija župskog teroara, kako u aromatici, tako i na ukusu.

HRANA: Ovo vino savršeno će se sljubiti i sa najzahtevnijim jelima intenzivnih ukusa i začina na bazi crvenih mesa i divljači, ali će biti savršen par i roštiljskim specijalitetima, kao i jelima sve popularnije azijske kuhinje kojima dominira soya sos ili teriyaki sos.

NAPOMENA: Preporučuje se dekantiranje minimum 15 do 30 minuta, po mogućnosti i duže.

name: Burgundac sivi
short_description:
Burgundac sivi je 100 %  sortno vino nastalo od istoimene sorte (Pinot grigio, Pinot gris). Ovo vino je vino alzaškog tipa, izuzetno snažnog karaktera, jakog uljastog tela, intenzivnog ukusa i visokog, ali dobro izbalansiranog alkohola od 13,5 %.

Obiluje aromama južnog voća, kruške, dinje, sa bademastom dugom završnicom.

Preporučuje se isključivo uz dobar zalogaj koji će činiti rečna riba poput soma, smuđa, šarana, kao i uz morsku ribu i razna pečenja intenzivnog ukusa čija će se tekstura sljubiti sa kompleksnom strukturom i punoćom ukusa ovog vina. Nastalo je iz ljubavi prema sorti i kao želja vlasnika vinarije da stvori vino od navedene sorte u kakvom je i sam želeo da uživa.
description:
UKUSI: Vino alzaškog tipa, izuzetno snažnog karaktera, jakog uljastog tela, intenzivnog ukusa i visokog, ali dobro izbalansiranog alkohola od 13,5 %.

MIRISI: Obiluje aromama južnog voća, kruške, dinje, sa bademastom dugom završnicom.

HRANA: Preporučuje se isključivo uz dobar zalogaj koji će činiti rečna riba poput soma, smuđa, šarana, kao i uz morsku ribu i razna pečenja intenzivnog ukusa.

name: Askurđel
short_description:
Askurđel predstavlja kupažu sorti Italijanski rizling i autohtone Smederevke, sa već dobro poznatog poteza Varina u okolini sela Trnavci u vinorodnoj Župi. Specifičan mikroklimat lokacije, kao i podloga koju čini beli vulkanski tuf, u Župi poznat kao belobrežina, daje mu izuzetnu mineralnost kao i poseban voćni, gotovo muskatni aromatski karakter, iako u samoj kupaži ne učestvuje ni jedna muskatna sorta.

Ime je poneo po terminu koji predstavlja pretka sedmog kolena, koji je u konkretnom slučaju i predak familije koji je prvi poneo prezime Radenković.

Uz dopadljivu kiselinu iza koje se krije gotovo neprimetnih 13% alkohola fantastično će se složiti sa belim mesom, belim sosevima, belom ribom, svim vrstama salata, kao i svim vsrtama testa i pizza, a neće biti u svađi ni sa roštiljom.

MIRISI: Poseban voćni, gotovo muskatni aromatski karakter, iako u samoj kupaži ne učestvuje ni jedna muskatna sorta.

HRANA: Fantastično će se složiti sa belim mesom, belim sosevima, belom ribom, svim vrstama salata, kao i svim vsrtama testa i pizza, a neće biti u svađi ni sa roštiljom.
